verified: A 128×128 PNG extension icon is required; square artwork normally occupies 96×96 with 16px transparent padding.
Small promo: 440×280. Marquee: 1400×560. Screenshots: 1280×800 or 640×400, with full bleed and square corners.
The icon and at least one screenshot are mandatory. Assets do not guarantee placement or rankings.
The plain-text extension name is limited to 75 characters.
The plain-text summary is limited to 132 characters.
Localized catalogs use _locales/CODE/messages.json. default_locale is required when _locales exists.
